You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:

content.text:
Clinical history (case record; may contain prior observations):
age: 52
gender: female
history: A 52-year-old female patient presented with breathlessness on exertion for 3 months. She also complained of dry cough for a month which did not respond to antibiotics. There was no history of haemoptysis, cough with expectoration or chest pain.

Based on the chest X-ray findings, what is the most likely diagnosis for this 52-year-old female patient presenting with breathlessness on exertion and a dry cough for a month? Consider the reticulo-nodular pattern and nodular opacities as seen in the chest X-ray images. Which of the following conditions best fits the observed radiographic features and clinical history?

A) Tuberculosis with cavitary lesions
B) Sarcoidosis with bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy
C) Pneumoconiosis with upper lobe predominance
D) Lymphoma with mediastinal mass
E) Silicosis with nodular opacities
F) Pulmonary fibrosis with honeycombing
